kids.title: With children
kids.hint: Baby care rooms and play area
kids.text: The international terminal has a children’s play area and baby care rooms open around the clock. The baby care rooms provide changing facilities, seating and privacy.

parking.title: Parking
parking.text: The car park in front of the international terminal is open around the clock, with payment on exit. For passenger cars with up to 9 seats inclusive, the first 30 minutes cost 9,000 VND and each subsequent 30 minutes cost 4,000 VND. These rates apply from 1 June 2025 until further notice.

wifi.title: Wi-Fi
wifi.text: Free Wi-Fi is available in all areas of the international terminal around the clock. Free device charging stations also operate around the clock in various parts of the terminal.
